items.samenvatting_bron: None. Zaak:

document.tekst_begin: Aanleiding Op vrijdagmiddag 25 september jl. heeft het NCSC vertrouwelijk haar doelgroep geïnformeerd over twee ernstige kwetsbaarheden in Citrix Netscaler. Citrix Netscaler zorgt ervoor dat websites en applicaties snel en betrouwbaar bereikbaar blijven. Dit wordt gebruikt om thuiswerken te faciliteren. De kwetsbaarheden werden/worden actief misbruikt, en de kans op misbruik neemt toe naarmate de bekendheid van de kwetsbaarheden toeneemt. Met deze Kamerbrief wordt de Kamer geïnformeerd over de situatie en de genomen maatregelen om de impact te beperken. Geadviseerd besluit Kennisnemen van de inhoud van deze nota en akkoord gaan met verzending van de Kamerbrief. Kern Afgelopen vrijdag heeft NCSC gemeld dat er ernstige kwetsbaarheden zijn in Citrix. In de brief wordt toegelicht welke acties in gang zijn gezet binnen de rijksoverheid en wat de stand van zaken op dit moment is. Motivering In de openbaar gemaakte versie van deze nota zijn alle persoonsgegevens van ambtenaren geanonimiseerd. items.titel: Procedimenti ambientali complessi e tutela europea della biodiversità: deroghe per le specie protette, termini di impugnazione e accesso alla giustizia
items.samenvatting_bron: This article examines, in the light of the Court of Justice’s judgment in Drumakilla, the relationship between the strict protection of animal species under the Habitats Directive, the environmental impact assessment process and national rules governing judicial review. The Court held that EU law does not preclude a Member State from treating a derogation granted under Article 16 of the Habitats Directive as an autonomous act subject to a three-month limitation period, even where that period may expire before final development consent is issued. Such procedural autonomy remains subject to equivalence and effectiveness, actual or reasonable knowledge of both the operative part and the reasons of the decision, and foreseeability of the applicable remedy. The judgment departs from Advocate General Medina’s integrated approach, under which the period could not expire before final consent. The analysis shows that the Court separates the substantive unity of environmental decision-making from the procedural autonomy of its component acts and insufficiently addresses the cumulative burden generated by multiple authorisations and proceedings. The comparison with French, German and Italian law points towards a model of procedural integration without mandatory institutional fusion.

items.titel: evealing the stream, reconnecting the city: the impact of Zürich’s bachkonzept on pedestrian networks and active living
items.samenvatting_bron: The burial and culverting of urban streams during twentieth-century urbanization severed the relationship between natural hydrological systems and the built environment, resulting in the loss of critical ecosystem services. While urban waterways are often perceived as barriers to movement, their reinstatement at ground level through ‘stream daylighting’ presents an opportunity to reconfigure urban form in ways that support both ecological and social resilience. This study investigates the impact of stream daylighting on pedestrian network connectivity in Zurich, Switzerland. Using a comparative spatial analysis of pre-and post-daylighting conditions, the study employs a configurational approach based on metric reach within a GIS environment. Historic georeferenced maps from 1984 were digitized and compared with 2020 open-access spatial data to assess changes in route network connectivity. These quantitative findings are complemented by photographic documentation to evaluate the urban design interventions accompanying daylighting projects. Contrary to the assumption that reinstating streams at ground level disrupts connectivity, the results reveal that daylighting in Zurich often enhances pedestrian accessibility. This is achieved through integrated urban design strategies, such as the inclusion of footbridges and the creation of new public spaces, which maintain or improve existing route networks. document.tekst_begin: Position paper voor rondetafelgesprek over Post-Covid/PAIS Oktober 2026, namens Janette Tazmi, verpleegkundig specialist bij Laurens Laurens is een VVT-organisatie in de regio Rotterdam-Rijnmond en biedt sinds juli 2024 tijdelijke opname en behandeling (klinisch herstel) na post-covid/PAIS. In totaal zijn 18 cliënten opgenomen, waarvan 5 nog in zorg. Daarnaast hebben we cliënten op de wachtlijst die binnen de kaders van het hersteltraject vallen. We oriënteren ons op uitbreiding van het zorgpad Post-Covid/PAIS, onder meer via scholing voor zorgprofessionals en mogelijke vergroting van onze woon- en herstelvoorziening. Onze dringende oproep aan de Tweede Kamer: Maak een langer, multidisciplinair hersteltraject mogelijk om mensen met post-covid weer perspectief te bieden op een betere toekomst! Wat wij doen en welke cliënten wij zien Op locatie Intermezzo Zuid biedt Laurens een klinisch hersteltraject voor (huisgebonden) cliënten met een ernstig en complex beloop van post-covid, die kampen met langdurige fysieke en mentale beperkingen. Jonge mensen, die midden in het leven stonden. 1 Hen wordt een omgeving geboden waarin maximaal rekening wordt gehouden met hun prikkelgevoeligheid.

document.tekst_begin: Tweede Kamer der Staten-Generaal 2 Vergaderjaar 2025–2026 29 214 Subsidiebeleid VWS Nr. 115 BRIEF VAN DE MINISTER VAN LANGDURIGE ZORG, JEUGD EN SPORT Aan de Voorzitter van de Tweede Kamer der Staten-Generaal Den Haag, 17 augustus 2026 Hierbij bied ik u het ontwerpbesluit houdende de wijziging van de subsidieregeling opvang kinderen van ouders met een trekkend/varend bestaan (hierna: de subsidieregeling) aan, in verband met de verlenging van de werkingsduur en de aanpassing van (de berekening van) de bedragen in de regeling. De huidige subsidieregeling kent een verval- datum van 01-01-2027. De onderhavige wijzigingsregeling ziet op de verlenging van de werkingsduur van de subsidieregeling van 01-01-2027 tot 01-01-2032 (de maximaal toegestane periode van vijf jaar, conform artikel 4.10, tweede lid, van de Comptabiliteitswet 2016). Sinds 2025 neemt de WIA-instroom van mensen met Post-Covid af. Aantal toegekende WIA-uitkeringen van personen tot 60 jaar in de sectoren zorg en welzijn, openbaar bestuur en onderwijs naar ziektebeeld (hoofddiagnose), 1e halfjaar 2022–1e halfjaar 2025*1 * De diagnose is deels geschat. In het eerste halfjaar van 2024 is de diagnose van 9% van de WIA-instroom namelijk nog niet bekend. In het eerste halfjaar van 2025 gaat het om 18%. Waar ons leven ooit gevuld was met school, werk, sport, vrienden en toekomstdromen, is nu een paar uur werken of onderwijs volgen vaak al te veel. Terwijl anderen, en misschien u ook, op onze leeftijd samen of op zichzelf woonden, diploma's haalden, promotie maakten, en kinderen kregen, zetten wij noodgedwongen stappen terug. Long covid beperkt ons in het volgen van een opleiding en onze stap naar volwassenheid. Sommigen van ons kunnen helemaal niet naar school, studie of werk, anderen een paar uur of alleen onder zeer specifieke omstandigheden. Wij willen graag bijdragen aan de samenleving, op de manier die onze gezondheid toelaat. Sinds de start van deze expertisecentra op 1 februari 2026 zijn er landelijk ruim 300 kinderen gezien. Kinderen worden onderzocht door multidisciplinaire teams, die de zorg afstemmen op de klachten en behoeften van iedere patiënt. Kabinetsinzet en voorgenomen positie Het kabinet is een voorstander van actief en ambitieus EU-handelsbeleid, waarvan handelsakkoorden een belangrijk onderdeel vormen. Zoals in de Beleidsbrief Buitenlandse Zaken aangegeven, spoort het kabinet de Commissie aan tot het sluiten van nieuwe handels- en investeringsverdragen. Hierbij wordt ingezet op groene economische partnerschappen die lokale economieën stimuleren.1 Handelsverdragen kunnen bijdragen aan de economische weerbaarheid van de EU en aan het mitigeren van risicovolle strategische afhankelijkheden door diversificatie van handelspartners. document.tekst_begin: Terwijl ik vanuit bed de laatste hand leg aan dit document, is mijn vrouw met onze twee jonge kinderen buiten op pad. Door de ziekte kan ik niet mee. Dat gaat heel vaak zo. Een chronische ziekte met ongelooflijke lijdensdruk, waar artsen geen raad mee weten. Een ziekte die niet serieus behandeld wordt in hun opleiding, en zonder werkbare up-to-date richtlijnen. En dus geen volwaardig zorgaanbod op basis van de huidige kennis. Tegelijkertijd is er ook geen langetermijn plan met perspectief op betere zorg. Er is geen zorgkoepel die eigenaarschap neemt over dit probleem. items.titel: Delineating and Mapping Green Infrastructure Systems: A Case Study of Central Wuhan, China
items.samenvatting_bron: Green infrastructure (GI) is widely recognized as an essential solution for addressing urban environmental issues such as pollution, flooding, urban heat islands, and climate change. However, despite its increasing importance, a unified definition and classification system for green infrastructure has yet to be established. This study selected the central urban area of Wuhan as the study area, where extensive urban development coexists with diverse ecological spaces. Based on web map AOI data, high-resolution remote sensing imagery (approximately meter-level spatial resolution), the Third National Land Survey, and urban planning databases, a green infrastructure classification system encompassing natural, semi-natural and artificial elements was identified and constructed through multisource spatial data integration and deep learning-assisted image interpretation. Landscape indices were used to measure the connectivity and fragmentation of green infrastructure landscapes within the city, including metrics such as contagion, Shannon diversity index, and edge density. Finally, the Minimum Cumulative Resistance (MCR) model and the gravity model were employed to construct the green infrastructure network. items.titel: From cemeteries to ecological memorial landscapes: the rise of green and conservation burial grounds and its opportunities for urban planning
items.samenvatting_bron: The article conducts an interpretative review of contemporary scientific literature (2000–2026) to analyse the environmental aspects of conventional funeral practices and introduces sustainable burial cemetery models such as green cemetery and conservation burial grounds. The interdisciplinary literature review covers landscape architecture, urban planning, urban ecology, environmental sciences, and sustainable development research. The ecological memorial landscapes, which promote human biomass “return” back into biological cycles, could create ecosystems that merge into urban green infrastructure networks, and transform the end-of-life into an active mechanism for environmental preservation. City planners and landscape architects are uniquely positioned to promote this sustainable model by reimagining and zoning cemeteries as urban green infrastructure. This study suggests that despite legal, religious, and cultural barriers, the rise of eco burial practices signals a generational evolution and shift toward ecological accountability and “death positivity” movement.

items.samenvatting_bron: Introduction Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA) contains highly diverse aquatic and terrestrial ecosystems but remains underrepresented in biodiversity research. Methods A systematic review following PRISMA 2020 was conducted using Google Scholar and Scopus for studies published from January 2018 to April 2026. Eligible peer-reviewed English-language studies used eDNA or DNA metabarcoding to assess aquatic or terrestrial biodiversity in SSA. items.titel: Marine Mammal Monitoring Research from 2014 to 2023: A Bibliometric Analysis of Collaboration, Technological Trends and Research Themes
items.samenvatting_bron: Marine mammal monitoring research has expanded considerably alongside developments in acoustic, remote-sensing, telemetry, molecular, and computational approaches. This study used bibliometric analysis to characterise the structure and evolution of research published between 2014 and 2023. A total of 2586 peer-reviewed publications retrieved from the Web of Science Core Collection were analysed using CiteSpace to examine publication trends, collaboration networks, keyword co-occurrence, temporal clusters, and citation bursts. Annual publication output increased from 155 articles in 2014 to a peak of 362 in 2022, while collaboration networks revealed prominent research hubs across North America, Europe, Asia, and Oceania. Passive acoustic monitoring remained a persistent and highly connected theme, alongside habitat modelling, environmental impact assessment, and conservation research. Temporal and keyword analyses indicated increasing attention to machine learning, artificial intelligence, remote sensing, and environmental DNA, reflecting a broader movement towards automated and multimodal monitoring approaches. items.titel: Beyond Structural Barriers: Storytelling, Affect and Municipal Responsibility in Urban NBS Implementation
items.samenvatting_bron: Nature-based solutions (NBS) are valuable instruments for climate adaptation and resilience. Existing research on urban NBS barriers focuses mostly on structural and technical elements, while co-creation and local knowledge are regularly cited as critical for successful implementation. Even when barriers are easy to identify, a divide between ambition and reality generates procedural and knowledge gaps. This paper addresses this challenge through a case study of the Horizon Europe project URBREATH. Narrative inquiry is used to reveal invisible aspects of NBS implementation as experienced by city officials from Madrid, Cluj-Napoca, Leuven, and Tallinn. items.titel: Spatiotemporal Evolution and Driving Forces of Green Spaces in Shrinking Cities
items.samenvatting_bron: Urban shrinkage causes inefficient land utilization and landscape fragmentation. Green spaces are critical nature-based solutions for the sustainable development of shrinking cities, and play an important role in enhancing urban environmental quality and promoting residents’ physical and mental well-being. Using landscape ecological indices (PLAND, NP, and LPI) coupled with the spatial Durbin model (SDM), geographically weighted regression (GWR) and multiscale geographically weighted regression (MGWR), this study investigates the dynamics and influencing factors of green space in shrinking cities from 2000 to 2020. The results show that cities with population shrinkage experience the concurrent expansion and fragmentation of green spaces, cities with economic shrinkage demonstrate modest changes accompanied by low fragmentation, and cities with social shrinkage face a decline in green spaces with reduced patch numbers. The dynamics of green space are driven by the interplay of socioeconomic and natural factors, where the former operate at broader spatial scales and the latter exert localized influences. Consequently, spatial governance of urban green spaces should be implemented through multidimensional and multi-scalar coordinated strategies.

Daarbij heeft de minister van Landbouw, Visserij, Voedselzekerheid en Natuur toegezegd dat u de Kamer een oordeel over deze motie zou doen toekomen. Geadviseerd besluit Bijgevoegde appreciatie te verzenden aan de Tweede Kamer. Kern De motie kan oordeel kamer worden gegeven. De appreciatie van de motie is afgestemd met B&E, VB en LVVN. Toelichting Dit najaar krijgen gemeenten inzicht in of de opgaven op hen van toepassing zijn en werken we met hen toe naar een optimale begrenzing van de stedelijke ecosysteemgebieden die kan worden opgenomen in het definitieve natuurplan. De stand van zaken daarop kan voor het eind van het jaar worden gecommuniceerd. items.samenvatting_bron: None. Zaak:

document.tekst_begin: Aanleiding Op 11 september 2026 heeft u aan de Tweede Kamer een brief gestuurd over de voortgang van het voorstel Wet versterking waarborgfunctie Awb. De Tweede Kamer heeft deze brief geagendeerd voor het commissiedebat Grondrechten op 27 oktober 2026. De vaste commissie Binnenlandse Zaken heeft gevraagd om drie dagen voorafgaand aan dat debat een aantal feitelijke vragen te beantwoorden. Deze antwoorden - die u mede namens de StasJenV geeft - worden u bij deze nota ter ondertekening voorgelegd. StasJenV heeft inmiddels ingestemd met de beantwoording. Geadviseerd besluit U wordt geadviseerd bijgevoegde aanbiedingsbrief te ondertekenen. Kern • De Kamer stelt 41 feitelijke vragen. • De vragen gaan over de kosten van de verschillende onderdelen en over de verhouding tussen de doelstelling van het wetsvoorstel, de in de uitvoeringstoetsen begrote kosten en de gereserveerde middelen. Toelichting • In de antwoorden worden gemaakte keuzes uitgelegd en wordt aangegeven dat de definitieve keuze voor de inhoud van het wetsvoorstel wordt gemaakt als de aanvullende uitvoeringstoetsen zijn verwerkt. • Daarnaast zendt u desgevraagd de tekst van het aangepaste wetsvoorstel en de aangepaste memor

Deze toezegging volgde op de vraag van het Kamerlid Sneller naar de stand van zaken van het wetsvoorstel en het verzoek om inzichtelijk te maken welke onderdelen van het voorstel kosten met zich meebrengen. Bijgevoegde conceptbrief strekt tot nakoming van die toezegging. Op 2 juli spreekt u gezamenlijk over deze brief en de implicaties van de voortgang van het wetsvoorstel. Het direct sturen van de brief aan de Tweede Kamer zonder behandeling in de MR. Ad a. Tijdens het tweeminutendebat BES van 17 juni jl. heeft u uw lezing van de motie toegelicht en daarmee de strekking van de motie ingekaderd. document.tekst_begin: Position paper Rondetafelgesprek ‘Zon op dak: van potentie naar realisatie’ 21 oktober 2026 Zonnestroom moet blijven lonen: geef consumenten zekerheid na 2027 De Consumentenbond kan zich vinden in de ambitie om meer beschikbare daken in Nederland te benutten voor zonnestroom. Zonnepanelen helpen consumenten hun woonlasten te verlagen en geven de mogelijkheid bij te dragen aan de energietransitie. 40 procent van de woningen heeft al zonnepanelen. Het merendeel van huishoudens profiteert nu dus nog niet van elektriciteit die door de panelen op hun eigen dak is opgewekt. Om ook deze consumenten mee te kunnen nemen, moeten zij erop kunnen vertrouwen dat dit financieel aantrekkelijk is en blijft. Het bredere vertrouwen in de energietransitie loopt schade op nu zonnepanelen, die consumenten jarenlang werden aangeraden, door een wijziging in het overheidsbeleid onrendabel dreigen te worden. Dat werkt door in de bereidheid van consumenten om mee te gaan in andere noodzakelijke veranderingen in de energietransitie.12 Voor de Consumentenbond is dit al langere tijd een belangrijk zorgpunt. document.tekst_begin: Een slim energiesysteem met zon als basis Elektrische toepassingen gaan veel efficiënter om met energie dan fossiele verbranding, waarbij veel energie in de vorm van warmte verloren gaat. Daarom is kiest het Nationaal Plan Energiesysteem (NPE) ook voor elektrificatie als hoofdroute voor verduurzaming. Ook in de gebouwde omgeving is de keuze voor elektrificatie de juiste stap. Waar warmtenetten geen optie zijn vormen zonnepanelen, warmtepompen, elektrische auto’s, batterijen en energiemanagement samen één duurzaam en slim geheel. Door het elektriciteitsgebruik af te stemmen op het aanbod kunnen huishoudens en bedrijven meer van hun eigen zonnestroom benutten, hun energiekosten verlagen en het elektriciteitsnet ontlasten. Zo blijft verdere elektrificatie en verduurzaming ook bij netcongestie mogelijk. Beleid voor het stimuleren van zonne-energie moet zich daarom richten op het realiseren van opwek in combinatie met slimme afnametechnieken die eigen zonnestroom efficiënt benutten. Het vergroten van het eigen verbruik van zonnestroom vormt de basis voor de nieuwe businesscase voor zon op dak. Nederland heeft nog veel potentie om zon op dak te ontwikkelen. Geadviseerd besluit U wordt geadviseerd, mede namens de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties, in te stemmen met het verzenden van de antwoorden aan de Tweede Kamer. Om de doelen uit het hernieuwde Nationaal Plan Energiesysteem (NPE) te behalen, zijn er echter nog veel meer zonnepanelen op daken en objecten nodig. Nederland beschikt over een aanzienlijk theoretisch potentieel voor zonne-energie op woningen, bedrijfsgebouwen, maatschappelijk vastgoed, gevels en parkeerterreinen. Ondanks de inzet van veel regio’s, provincies en gemeenten zien we in de praktijk dat de realisatie van zonprojecten stagneert. De eenvoudig te realiseren projecten zijn grotendeels ontwikkeld. Wat resteert, zijn vaak complexere en duurdere projecten. document.tekst_begin: Tweede Kamer der Staten-Generaal 2 Vergaderjaar 2025–2026 33 529 Gaswinning Nr. 1383 BRIEF VAN DE MINISTER VAN BINNENLANDSE ZAKEN EN KONINKRIJKSRELATIES Aan de Voorzitter van de Tweede Kamer der Staten-Generaal Den Haag, 25 augustus 2026 Afgelopen vrijdag werden we weer opgeschrikt door een aardbeving bij Zandeweer. Bevingen waarvan we weten dat ze kunnen blijven voorkomen, maar die ons ook elke keer onaangenaam verrassen. Een beving die bij de bewoners in Groningen weer keihard binnenkomt. Het maakt ook opnieuw duidelijk hoe belangrijk de voortgang van de versterkingsoperatie is. Daarom valt het dilemma dat ik in deze brief schets mij des te zwaarder. Met deze brief informeer ik uw Kamer over de inzet van zelfstandigen bij de Nationaal Coördinator Groningen (NCG), de toepassing van de Wet Deregulering Beoordeling Arbeidsrelaties (DBA) en de mogelijke gevolgen daarvan voor de voortgang van de versterkings- operatie. Externe inhuur NCG NCG werkt met een combinatie van vaste medewerkers en externe capaciteit. items.titel: Neighbourhood Built Environment and Sense of Community in Tropical Residential Neighbourhoods: An Observation-Based Comparative Study in Malaysia
items.samenvatting_bron: The neighbourhood-built environment plays an important role in shaping social interaction and the development of a sense of community, particularly in rapidly urbanising tropical cities. While previous Malaysian studies have primarily used perception-based surveys, limited empirical attention has been given to the actual observation of physical neighbourhood features and their influence on social interaction and community cohesion. This study uses an observational analysis of two master-planned townships in Shah Alam, Selangor: Setia Alam and Bukit Jelutong, to evaluate the link between neighbourhood-built environment characteristics and a sense of community. A structured observation protocol was employed to assess eleven neighbourhoodbuilt environment attributes, including residential density, green infrastructure, architectural style, and recreational facilities, using a three point assessment scale. The findings indicate that although both neighbourhoods possess physical characteristics that support community development, they achieve these outcomes through different spatial planning approaches. Setia Alam scores in architectural, housing design excellence, and strong urban integration, promoting community identity and social interactions. items.titel: Lisbon
items.samenvatting_bron: This chapter examines how Lisbon’s climate‑neutrality agenda intersects with long‑standing socio‑spatial inequalities, housing precarity, and contested urban development paths. It reconstructs the historical and demographic trajectories that have shaped the Portuguese capital, highlighting the legacies of colonialism, touristification, and financialisation in producing uneven access to housing, mobility, and energy‑efficient dwellings. The chapter analyses the evolution of Lisbon’s climate governance architecture, from early commitments under the Covenant of Mayors to the Climate Action Plan 2030 and participation in the European Union’s mission for climate‑neutral and smart cities, focusing on the role of municipal departments, the energy and environment agency Lisboa E‑Nova, and an expanding ecosystem of open‑data platforms. It then explores how specific policies and projects in mobility, green infrastructure, water management, energy retrofitting, and the circular economy translate strategic visions into experiments on the ground, while also generating new distributive and procedural dilemmas. Particular attention is paid to forms of citizen participation and climate activism, including participatory budgeting, citizens’ assemblies, and climate‑justice movements, and to their ambivalent relationship with institutional initiatives.

items.titel: Construction of Dynamic Ecological Networks in Large-Scale Open-Pit Mining Areas on the Loess Plateau
items.samenvatting_bron: The Loess Plateau is a typical ecologically fragile area, where long-term intensive open-pit mining triggers severe vegetation loss, habitat fragmentation, and biodiversity decline. Although ecological network analysis integrating circuit theory and complex-network topology has become a mainstream connectivity assessment tool, existing studies mainly focus on urban agglomerations, nature reserves, and mountainous regions. Long-term dynamic networks considering mining and reclamation remain insufficiently understood in large coalfields. Taking the Pingshuo mining area as a case, this study combined MSPA, the MCR model, circuit theory, and complex-network approaches using remote-sensing images (1985, 1995, 2005, 2015, 2025), DEM, and road data to analyze 41-year spatiotemporal changes and propose a 2025 optimization plan. Ecological source proportion dropped from 6.17% (1985) to 3.56% (2015), then recovered to 9.79% (2025), dominated by forests and grasslands. Corridor length declined from 150.90 km to 99.32 km, and the 2025 network showed an average degree of 1.82 and an average path length of 1.45, indicating fragility. Under the proposed optimization scenario, node connectivity and network stability were projected to improve substantially. This study reveals how mining and restoration jointly shape ecological networks, offering a model-based theoretical framework for ecological security planning in similar fragile mining regions.

Generally, data from metabarcoding consist of a table of read‐counts assigned to each of a set of taxa or sequence variants. As such, they appear to contain quantitative information about the environment under study, immediately eligible for traditional community ecology analyses. items.titel: Synthesizing lessons from European adaptation pathways projects for climate resilience
items.samenvatting_bron: Climate adaptation planning faces challenges due to deep uncertainty and complex socio-ecological systems, often resulting in fragmented and incremental responses. This study synthesizes experiences from 21 cities and regions across eight European Union-funded projects, employing diverse methodologies to develop adaptation pathways that sequence climate adaptation measures over time. items.titel: Diminishing cooling returns of urban greening amid a warming climate
items.samenvatting_bron: Urban greening is widely prioritized as a nature-based solution to mitigating intensifying heat extremes in the context of climate change, yet its long-term global efficacy remains inadequately quantified. Here we present a two-decade assessment of vegetation dynamics and associated cooling effects across 3,806 urban clusters worldwide, integrating multisource satellite observations with ground measurements from 4,855 meteorological stations. We identify a pronounced climate equity gap: While cities in the Global North have largely expanded green infrastructure, they exhibit cooling saturation with diminishing biophysical returns. Conversely, most cities in the Global South show vegetation stagnation or loss, compounding rapid warming trends. This asymmetry exposes a critical climate justice challenge, indicating that current greening efforts are insufficient to offset a warming trend. Our findings underscore the necessity for context-specific, integrated climate adaptation frameworks that address both the quantity and quality of urban vegetation to achieve equitable thermal resilience in an increasingly warm world.

items.titel: Hydraulic Modelling and Traditional Water Management for Nature-Based Flood Adaptation: A Spatial Planning Framework in the Lower Segura Basin (SE Spain)
items.samenvatting_bron: Flood adaptation in Mediterranean river basins requires approaches addressing floodwater circulation, redistribution and accumulation. This study proposes an exploratory spatial planning framework integrating two-dimensional hydraulic modelling, official flood hazard mapping and traditional water-management knowledge to identify potential Nature-based Solutions (NbS). Applied to the lower Segura basin (southeastern Spain), HEC-RAS 6.6 simulations used spatially uniform extreme rainfall to analyse water depths, velocities and the depth–velocity index (h·v). Functional hydraulic corridors were delineated using a threshold of h·v ≥ 0.30 m2/s. Comparison of simulated inundation with official SNCZI T500 mapping revealed 106.11 km2 of overlap (31.59%:, 182.42 km2 identified exclusively by the model (54.31%) and 47.34 km2 identified exclusively by SNCZI (14.09%). Qualitative spatial correspondence with traditional boquera irrigation systems and azarbe drainage networks informed a preliminary green infrastructure proposal combining multifunctional corridors, drainage adaptations and Controlled Storage Areas. The framework demonstrates the potential of integrating hydraulic modelling and historical knowledge into territorial flood adaptation planning. However, the simulations were not independently validated, and the hydraulic effectiveness of the proposed NbS remains unquantified.

items.titel: ECOLOGICAL CHALLENGES AND CLIMATE CHANGE IN TÜRKİYE: RISKS, SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT AND ADAPTATION STRATEGIES
items.samenvatting_bron: This article examines the principal environmental challenges facing Türkiye in the context of climate change and considers policy options for strengthening ecological security and sustainable development. Based on a qualitative review of international assessments and national climate policy documents, the study analyses water stress, drought, extreme heat, wildfires, floods, coastal risks, biodiversity loss and greenhouse-gas emissions. It discusses the relationship between climate vulnerability and economic sectors, particularly energy, agriculture, urban infrastructure and tourism. The analysis highlights the importance of combining mitigation measures with adaptation planning, including renewable energy, energy efficiency, integrated water management, climate-resilient agriculture, early-warning systems and nature-based solutions. Türkiye's 2024–2030 climate mitigation and adaptation plans provide an institutional framework, while implementation depends on coordination among national and local authorities, businesses and communities. The article concludes that an integrated, evidence-based approach can reduce climate risks while supporting economic resilience and a fair green transition.

items.titel: Coupled ecological pressures in urban environments: regional heterogeneity and drivers of carbon and water footprints
items.samenvatting_bron: A synergistic assessment of carbon and water footprints is essential for capturing the complexity of compound ecological pressures in rapidly urbanizing cities. However, their spatial distributions and integrated mechanisms at the district scale remain insufficiently explored and quantified. This study develops a spatially explicit analytical framework that integrates carbon and three types of water footprints (on-site blue water, runoff blue water, and road runoff gray water) with spatial autocorrelation and the Optimal Parameters-based Geographical Detector (OPGD) method. The analysis focuses on six central districts in Guangzhou, China, and evaluates spatial clustering patterns alongside the joint effects of natural and human drivers. The results reveal significant intra-urban clustering and a distinct core–periphery gradient in ecological footprints. This pattern is shaped primarily by urbanization intensity, human activities, and natural features, and interactions among these drivers generate marked nonlinear amplification. Consequently, ecological burdens are concentrated in densely populated and intensively developed districts, exacerbating spatial inequality and exposing specific areas to elevated environmental risks. The convergence of high urbanization levels with overlapping ecological pressures underscores the urgency of targeted urban sustainability strategies. document.tekst_begin: Tweede Kamer der Staten-Generaal 2 Vergaderjaar 2025–2026 22 054 Wapenexportbeleid Nr. 490 BRIEF VAN DE MINISTERS VAN BUITENLANDSE HANDEL EN ONTWIKKELINGSSAMENWERKING EN VAN BUITENLANDSE ZAKEN Aan de Voorzitter van de Tweede Kamer der Staten-Generaal Den Haag, 19 augustus 2026 Conform het op 10 juni 2011 per brief gemelde aangescherpte wapenex- portbeleid (Kamerstuk 2010–2011, 22 054, nr. 165) en de motie van het lid El Fassed c.s. van 22 december 2011 over verlaging van de drempel- waarde voor de versnelde parlementaire controle bij specifieke wapenex- portaanvragen naar € 2.000.000,– (Kamerstuk 2011–2012, 22 054, nr. 181), ontvangt uw Kamer onderstaande informatie over een door Nederland afgegeven vergunning ter waarde van € 9.865.000,– voor uitvoer van militair materieel naar Vietnam. Een Nederlands bedrijf heeft onlangs een exportvergunning verkregen voor de uitvoer naar Vietnam van een radarsysteem met bijbehorende technologie. Het systeem komt in dienst van de Vietnamese marine en zal worden ingebouwd in een korvet bedoeld om de soevereiniteit van Vietnam te beschermen. De aanvraag is getoetst aan de acht criteria van het EU Gemeenschap- pelijk Standpunt inzake wapenexport.1

document.tekst_begin: Tweede Kamer der Staten-Generaal 2 Vergaderjaar 2025–2026 24 557 Kansspelen Nr. 285 BRIEF VAN DE STAATSSECRETARIS VAN JUSTITIE EN VEILIGHEID Aan de Voorzitter van de Tweede Kamer der Staten-Generaal Den Haag, 25 augustus 2026 Met deze brief bied ik uw Kamer het onderzoek «Deelname aan kansspelen in Europees Nederland: meting 2026» aan, uitgevoerd door Ipsos I&O. Voor de routekaart zijn vertegenwoordi- gende organisaties en het College voor de Rechten van de Mens actief betrokken. Doel van het toezicht was om te bepalen of Jeugdzorg verantwoorde vrijwillige ambulante jeugdzorg en jeugdbescherming verleent. De inspectie is bij haar onderzoek uitgegaan van de wettelijke bepaling dat de jeugdzorg in Caribisch Nederland van goed niveau is en in ieder geval veilig, doeltreffend, doelmatig en cliëntgericht wordt verleend en is afgestemd op de reële behoefte van de jeugdige. De leden hebben dit werkbezoek afgelegd uit hoofde van hun benoeming tot rapporteur Suriname, namens de commissie voor Buitenlandse Zaken. Het doel van het rapporteurschap is om de informatiepositie van de vaste commissie voor Buitenlandse Zaken over actuele ontwikkelingen in Suriname te versterken. Daarbij verkennen de rapporteurs welke kansen en uitda- gingen er zijn op beleidsterreinen die van belang zijn voor de bilaterale relatie tussen Nederland en Suriname, zoals rechtsstaat, handel, grond- stoffen, duurzame samenwerking, economische ontwikkeling en digitale soevereiniteit. Op basis van gesprekken en een verkennend werkbezoek brengen zij hun bevindingen terug aan de commissie, zodat deze kunnen worden benut bij toekomstige Kameractiviteiten. document.tekst_begin: Position paper Rondetafelgesprek Algemene Maatregel van Bestuur (AMvB) Dierwaardige veehouderij Prof. Dr. Saskia S. Arndt, Hoogleraar Diergedrag Universiteit Utrecht, faculteit Diergeneeskunde Innovatie in de veehouderij vraagt ook om innovatie op het terrein van dierenwelzijn De zes leidende principes zoals die in 2021 door de Raad voor Dierenaangelegenheden (RDA) zijn geformuleerd, vormen samen een normatief en praktisch kader voor een dierwaardige veehouderij. Ze sluiten inhoudelijk aan bij het Five Domains Model van Mellor et al. (1994, 2015, 2016, 2020), dat aandacht besteedt aan voeding, leefomgeving, gezondheid, gedrag en de daaruit voortkomende mentale ervaringen van dieren. De RDA voegt daaraan een expliciet ethisch uitgangspunt toe: erkenning van de intrinsieke waarde en integriteit van het dier. Dit uitgangspunt bepaalt mede hoe mensen hun omgang met dieren behoren in te richten. Dierwaardigheid en dierenwelzijn hangen nauw samen. Binnen de dynamische benadering van dierenwelzijn kan (positief) welzijn worden beschreven aan hand van het vermogen van een dier om mentaal en fysiek adequaat te reageren op positieve en negatieve prikkels uit zijn interne en externe omgeving.

items.titel: Cave Monitoring Network and Long-Term Ecological Research in Portugal
items.samenvatting_bron: This document describes the Portuguese Cave Monitoring Network (CaveNet), a scientific infrastructure established within the framework of the EcoSub Chair. CaveNet provides an integrated framework for the quantitative monitoring of caves in Portugal, encompassing data collection, validation, processing and storage. The document presents the architecture and objectives of the infrastructure, highlights its scientific and ecological relevance and characterises the sites selected for Long-Term Ecological Research in Portuguese caves (LTER-Grutas). These sites host monitoring stations whose long-term environmental and ecological data are integrated into CaveNet. The document further discusses the advantages of an integrated cave monitoring network and its direct applicability to the assessment and reporting of the conservation status of habitat type 8310 - Caves not open to the public - under the Natura 2000 framework, as well as to the implementation of the Nature Restoration Regulation. In addition, CaveNet has significant socio-economic value, particularly in supporting the assessment and management of occupational risks associated with exposure to environmental hazards during underground work. In the longer term, the infrastructure will enable innovative research on carbon fluxes across the atmosphere–soil–subsoil–groundwater continuum, subsurface radioactivity emissions and the implications of subterranean processes for ecosystem services. items.titel: Sustainable development practices and SDG integration in brownfield redevelopment
items.samenvatting_bron: This chapter examines how sustainable development principles and the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) can be systematically integrated into brownfield redevelopment to transform derelict and contaminated land into socially inclusive, environmentally restored, and economically productive urban assets. Drawing on the triple bottom line framework of environmental repair, economic viability, and social well-being, the chapter demonstrates how brownfield reuse inherently advances multiple SDGs simultaneously from improved public health and clean water to climate action, decent work, and sustainable cities. It reviews the international, European, and UK policy frameworks that drive sustainable brownfield practice, including the EU Green Deal, the National Planning Policy Framework, and associated funding mechanisms. Innovative and eco-friendly remediation techniques spanning bioremediation, phytoremediation, in-situ chemical treatment, nature-based solutions, and circular material reuse are evaluated for their sustainability credentials. The chapter further addresses adaptive reuse of existing structures, climate-resilient design, green infrastructure integration, and the social imperatives of community engagement, affordable housing, economic inclusion, and environmental justice. items.titel: Does the climate-adaptive city pilot policy exacerbate urban sprawl? Evidence from a quasi-natural experiment in China
items.samenvatting_bron: Although climate-adaptive policies are primarily designed to enhance urban resilience, they may also generate unintended consequences for urban spatial development. However, the impacts of climate-adaptive governance interventions on urban sprawl remain underexplored. This study employs double machine learning method to examine how the climate-adaptive urban pilot policy affects urban sprawl and the underlying mechanisms, using 285 Chinese prefecture-level cities from 2010 to 2021. Results show that pilot policy significantly promotes urban sprawl, a conclusion validated by robustness tests. Fiscal resource allocation and green infrastructure expansion are plausible potential pathways behind this effect, while land use efficiency and intensity show no significant impact. Noticeable heterogeneity exists across city characteristics; the policy generates a stronger sprawl effect in non-central cities than in central cities, and its impacts increase with city size. Along the urbanization gradient, the policy effect follows a U-shaped pattern and is most prominent in highly urbanized areas. Moreover, suggestive evidence points to policy-related spillovers from climate-adaptive pilot contributing to urban sprawl in adjacent regions. items.titel: แนวทางการพฒนาธรกจนนทนาการของกรงเทพมหานครในป 2569
items.samenvatting_bron: This article aims to examine and propose development approaches for Bangkok’s recreation business sector in 2026 within the context of contemporary urban development that emphasizes quality of urban life, the creative economy, and the experience economy. The study employs a literature review and conceptual analysis based on Urban Recreation, Leisure Studies, and Quality of Urban Life, integrated with the experience economy framework, to explain the role of recreation businesses in large metropolitan cities. The findings indicate that recreation businesses play a significant role in enhancing urban well-being, social interaction, and city livability, particularly in high-density urban contexts such as Bangkok. Appropriate development approaches include the provision of personalized recreation activities, investment in experience-based technologies, lifestyle-oriented marketing through micro-influencer strategies, and the development of recreation communities to support long-term business sustainability. In addition, policy-level recommendations are proposed, including the expansion of urban green spaces, support for creative businesses, and the promotion of creative districts. The study highlights that integrating economic, experiential, technological, and urban planning dimensions is essential for strengthening the competitiveness of Bangkok’s recreation business sector and supporting sustainable urban development in the long term.

items.titel: Why Do Goitered Gazelles Cross the Path of an Approaching Moving Object Instead of Fleeing?
items.samenvatting_bron: Animal–vehicle collisions are an important conservation concern. Although many studies examine road mortality and wildlife crossings, less is known about ungulates that run across the path of an approaching vehicle rather than simply fleeing. This study describes this behavior in goitered gazelles (Gazella subgutturosa) and examines its association with four recorded factors: approach category, group size, group composition, and month. In a forward stepwise logistic regression, approach category was associated with crossing behavior (Wald = 22.784, df = 2, p < 0.001). The odds of crossing were higher in the high-category group than in the low-category group (odds ratio = 2.36). However, the categories also differed in object type (cars, motor scooters, and bicycles/pedestrians), so the independent effect of speed cannot be separated from the effect of object type. Group size, group composition, and month did not meet the model’s entry criteria. These observational results identify an association, but do not determine whether path-crossing is a uniquely anti-predator response, a reaction to limited assessment time, or another form of behavior.

items.titel: On-site metabarcoding analysis of environmental DNA samples
items.samenvatting_bron: Abstract Environmental DNA metabarcoding is a powerful monitoring tool for assessing aquatic biodiversity, as well as the sustainability and impacts of fisheries and aquaculture. However, conventional laboratory workflows remain time-consuming and dependent on dedicated infrastructures. Here, we present a field trial of a fully portable, off-site eDNA metabarcoding pipeline that enables end-to-end analysis within a few days using compact equipment, including a BentoLab workstation and an Oxford Nanopore Technologies (ONT) MinION sequencer. The workflow was implemented during two international training courses in Norway and Brazil, where students and early career researchers collected environmental samples, extracted and amplified DNA, prepared DNA libraries, and sequenced on-site before performing bioinformatics and statistical analyses. In the case study detailed here, seven eDNA samples collected and analysed on-site in the Oslofjord allowed detection of 16 fish and elasmobranch species. Although overall diversity was lower than in earlier studies using Illumina-based sequencing, our protocol reliably detected key species and demonstrates that portable eDNA metabarcoding is feasible for rapid ecological assessment, surveillance of high-risk regions and/or deployment in remote or resource-limited settings.

items.titel: Persistence of sedimentary DNA in burrowing marine benthos: evidence from the decapod Upogebia major

Requiring only small environmental samples, eDNA analysis enables efficient assessment of the occurrence and distribution of target taxa based on eDNA detection and concentration. This approach is particularly effective for organisms difficult to observe and collect conventionally. However, knowledge of eDNA persistence in the environment remains limited. A better understanding of taxon-specific eDNA persistence is essential for accurate interpretation of eDNA data. Burrowing benthic organisms are suitable targets for eDNA-based surveys because they are difficult to collect and observe directly, making field surveys time-consuming and labor-intensive. However, little is known about the persistence of their eDNA. items.titel: Biogeographical context mediates land-use impacts on tropical soil multitrophic diversity
items.samenvatting_bron: Abstract 1. Soil communities are structured primarily by climate, soil properties and regional biogeographic history. In addition, land-use change is expected to reorganise soil multitrophic diversity in a predictable direction: by raising resource availability and disturbance, forest-to-pasture conversion should shift multitrophic communities from slow-growing organisms, dominated by fungi and large-bodied consumers, towards fast-growing ones, dominated by bacteria and small-bodied consumers. This prediction has been tested in temperate systems, where biogeographic and environmental heterogeneity is very different from the tropics. items.titel: Waterborne eDNA metabarcoding of the upper Llano River watershed (Texas, USA) detects regionally unreported green plant taxa
items.samenvatting_bron: Environmental DNA (eDNA) represents a promising preliminary tool for efficiently assessing biological diversity in locales where conducting intensive field surveys is logistically challenging, as in the case of west-central Texas. Its utility for characterizing biodiversity across broad spatial scales is amplified in lotic systems, which can transport eDNA several kilometers from its source and often contain signals from both aquatic and nearby terrestrial organisms. In the present study, we employed waterborne eDNA metabarcoding to broadly characterize regional green plant (Viridiplantae) diversity in two west-central Texas rivers, the North Llano River and the South Llano River, that constitute the upper reaches of the ecologically and economically important Llano River watershed. We detected taxa from 45 green plant families, encompassing both streptophytes and chlorophytes. Among these, 18 taxa had not been previously documented in the study area, representing putative novel distributional data pending direct field observations. Additionally, we assessed the influence of three methodological factors—sequencing depth, PCR template volume, and volume of water filtered—on detected diversity. Collectively, our findings highlight the value and limitations of eDNA metabarcoding for broad-scale biodiversity characterization and provide insights into the potentially unrecognized floristic diversity of understudied Texas rivers.

items.titel: Environmental DNA is an efficient tool for monitoring pesticide resistance mutations in pest insects
items.samenvatting_bron: Abstract BACKGROUND Environmental DNA (eDNA) metabarcoding is a revolutionary tool for monitoring biodiversity. In addition, eDNA can also detect the presence and frequency of nuclear genomic mutations in single‐species assays. In agricultural systems, this could provide a powerful tool for detecting and estimating the relative frequency of pesticide resistance mutations in pest arthropods, enabling more targeted resistance management. RESULTS We tested the possibility of using eDNA to detect the presence and frequency of mutations in the voltage‐gated sodium channel (VGSC) conferring pyrethroid resistance in the cabbage‐stem flea beetle (CSFB; Psylliodes chrysocephala ). We first tested the efficiency of eDNA for detecting mutations with a laboratory experiment, in which beetles with known resistance mutations were allowed to interact with cabbage ( Brassica rapa ) leaves. We then tested our approach with two field experiments. First, rapeseed ( Brassica napus ) leaves and individual beetles were collected to compare the relative frequencies of SNPs obtained from eDNA and conventional specimen‐based genotyping. Second, we used previously collected rapeseed stem‐bulk samples from various fields to explore the prevalence of resistance mutations. We show that plant‐derived eDNA can provide insights into the presence and frequency of resistance mutations, which are comparable to single beetle genotyping. items.titel: Achieving Good Quality of Coastal Waters: The Role of Policy Coherence across the Land–Sea Interface
items.samenvatting_bron: Coastal ecosystems are affected by pressures from both land and sea. Ensuring good ecosystem conditions therefore requires ecosystem-based management (EBM) that addresses pressures at their source, regardless of where they originate. The EU Water Framework Directive and Marine Strategy Framework Directive both employ EBM approaches. Yet despite their complementary aims, they fall short of enabling holistic source-to-sea management. Incoherences in scope, scale, and legal force hinder achieving their environmental objectives, while sectoral economic policies often prevail. Case studies from Norway, Finland, and France illustrate varied national responses to these design challenges in EU law. Despite their efforts, none of the cases achieved good coastal water quality. Revisions of EU legislation and policy are needed. Coherence in objectives and measures should be strengthened across the Directives, enabling clearer and better coordinated roles; procedural alignment should reduce duplication and enhance synergies; and stronger legal and financial steering is needed to influence sectoral policies.

items.titel: Cities with birdsong: the impact of forest city designation on bird biodiversity
items.samenvatting_bron: Nature-based solutions such as forest cities are emerging as effective approaches for achieving symbiosis between humans and other species within urban environments. This article centers on China’s National Forest City Designation (NFCD) policy and develops a framework to investigate its impact on biodiversity. This article tests this framework with two key tools: a novel dataset of large-scale birdwatching data from China and a difference-in-differences approach. Research findings reveal that the NFCD policy has spurred a 5.6%−8.0% rise in bird biodiversity, and the regular inspection mechanism guarantees the sustainability of this impact. Increased forest area, improved forest quality, and enhanced forest protection are the primary association mechanisms. Further analysis indicates that NFCD provides greater protection for non-endangered birds, larger-bodied birds, forest-dwelling birds, and resident birds. The NFCD policy yields better results in urban areas as well as regions administered by officials who are younger, better educated, or possess relevant experience. These findings provide novel insights into how tournament-style policies impact urban landscapes and biodiversity.

items.titel: Wetland plant biodiversity in China: a scoping evidence map linking ecosystem services, SDGs, and governance instruments
items.samenvatting_bron: Wetlands are biodiversity hotspots and critical nature-based solutions for water purification, climate regulation, and flood and coastal risk reduction, yet they remain among the world’s most threatened ecosystems. This scoping review synthesized 2,482 China-focused studies published between 2001 and 2026 to examine how wetland plant biodiversity supports ecosystem services and informs governance and United Nations. Multidimensional biodiversity, including taxonomic, compositional, functional, and phylogenetic attributes, was consistently linked to water-quality regulation, carbon sequestration, habitat provision, and flood protection. Major pressures included land conversion, hydrological alteration, pollution, coastal reclamation, invasive species, and climate change. Although few studies explicitly referenced SDGs or named policy instruments, substantial evidence supported SDG 6, 13, 14, and 15. Synthesized within a State–Function–Pressure–Response framework, the findings demonstrate that conserving wetland plant biodiversity is essential for sustaining ecosystem services and strengthening biodiversity-informed wetland governance in China.

The workshop format combined academic presentations, group discussions, and a field excursion to a botanic reserve park showcasing successful SDG interventions. A carefully selected group of DAAD Alumni, representing diverse academic disciplines, professional levels (ranging from professors to undergraduates), and geographic regions across the country, convened for a two-day intensive session. Participants drew on their experiences and local realities to deliberate on five thematic areas identified through in-depth literature review and consultations with academic mentors. This study presents an integrated and systematic framework for uncertainty and sensitivity analysis to evaluate the effectiveness of riparian revegetation in reducing downstream flood hazard, demonstrated in the Bundamba Creek sub-catchment, Australia. items.titel: Ecological restoration of the land-sea interface: practices, challenges, and prospects in the Yellow River Delta
items.samenvatting_bron: The ecological degradation of the Yellow River Delta is driven by the coupled effects of multiple land–river–sea stressors, including altered fluvial water and sediment regimes, seawater intrusion, biological invasions, and intensive human activities. However, existing restoration practices remain largely component-specific and therefore have limited capacity to address these interacting pressures. This review synthesizes multidisciplinary evidence to elucidate the major degradation processes, trace the evolution of restoration research, and characterize emerging synergistic restoration practices in the Yellow River Delta. The analysis reveals an increasing research emphasis on ecological connectivity, multi-objective coordination, and system-oriented restoration alongside earlier attention to water–sediment regulation and single-factor restoration. Based on representative practices, we further identify three complementary dimensions of synergistic restoration: elemental synergy, integrating hydrology, salinity, topography, and biological processes; spatial synergy, linking watershed, landscape, estuarine, and nearshore scales; and objective synergy, integrating invasive-species control with native habitat reconstruction. items.titel: A regeneration approach for water and climate sensitive cities in peri-urban zones
items.samenvatting_bron: Abstract The rapid expansion of urban areas, along with the increase of impervious surfaces and encroachment on floodplains, has resulted in significant challenges related to flood and climate risk, water quality, biodiversity, and preservation of essential ecosystem services. An effective approach to mitigate these impacts lies in Nature-based Solutions (NbS), which have emerged as promising strategies for enhancing both environmental sustainability and human well-being, and they have been demonstrated to play a pivotal role in climate change adaptation and mitigation. This research aims to quantify the potential effects of NbS on water- and climate-related ecosystem services over a specific site in Legnano city which is a peri-urban zone, western the Milan metropolitan area in the North-West of Italy. The study adopts an integrated approach to urban regeneration, examining how the implementation of NbS can enhance the provision of various ecosystem services. Specifically, pluvial flood storage, heat island mitigation and biodiversity are quantified as primary benefits in the study area. The paper emphasizes the improvement of service indicators through the NbS approach that can be applied to all urban areas, fostering the development of resilient cities and ensuring the well-being of both citizens and ecosystems.

items.samenvatting_bron: Abstract Climate change poses disproportionate threats to human health in sub-Saharan Africa (SSA), yet comprehensive evidence on implemented interventions remains under-researched. Understanding the scope and characteristics of existing climate-health interventions is essential for informing policy priorities and action in the region. We conducted a scoping review following Arksey and O'Malley's framework and PRISMA-ScR reporting guidelines. We systematically searched Google Scholar, PubMed, Web of Science, and Scopus for peer-reviewed empirical studies on climate-health interventions in SSA, with no date restrictions. Two reviewers independently screened 3009 records. A total of 36 studies reporting 350 interventions were included. items.titel: Decoupling hydraulic and treatment optima in floating treatment islands: implications for nature-based solutions in stormwater systems
items.samenvatting_bron: Floating treatment islands (FTIs) are increasingly deployed as nature-based solutions (NbS) in urban stormwater systems. However, conventional design relies on empirical hydraulic proxies, lacking a physics-based framework that integrates multi-scale flow processes with localized reaction kinetics. This study presents a technical increment by quantifying the 3D multi-scale coupling between system-scale hydrodynamics and localized root-zone pollutant uptake using validated computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulations of a full-scale stormwater pond. The results reveal a clear physical decoupling between hydraulic and treatment optima. Hydraulic efficiency, governed by flow redistribution and short-circuiting mitigation, associated with improved flow distribution and reduced short-circuiting, is maximised at a root-length-to-pond-depth ratio (LR/DP) of approximately 0.50. Conversely, FTI pollutant mass removal – driven by local advective flux and residence time within the porous root matrix – reaches an individual maximum near LR/DP ≈ 0.65, with the upstream island achieving 52% removal. Crucially, system-scale pollutant removal plateaus beyond LR/DP = 0.50 (62% at both 0.50 and 0.65), as flow blockage by deep upstream roots induces hydraulic shielding over downstream structures. Consequently, LR/DP ≈ 0.50 represents a robust, physics-informed design optimum, maximizing water quality benefits while preserving hydraulic performance, structural stability, and cost-efficiency.

items.titel: Transformações no uso e cobertura da terra e seus reflexos socioambientais em uma bacia hidrográfica periurbana de Campo Grande – Mato Grosso do Sul
items.samenvatting_bron: Disordered urbanization, characterized by excessive soil sealing, inadequate structural interventions, and effluent discharge, results in severe water degradation, a scenario historically observed in Campo Grande − Mato Grosso do Sul. In this context, this study analyzed the socio-environmental impacts of urbanization and macro-drainage works in a peri-urban watershed in the northern zone of the city. The methodology integrated the analysis of geotechnical maps, cartographic materials, the MapBiomas historical series (1985–2024), and fieldwork. The results demonstrated a drastic alteration in the landscape: the urbanized area jumped from 12.70% in 1985 to 42.72% in 2024, reducing native vegetation to only 13.06%. Rapid urban growth on fragile soils (Entisols - Quartzipsamments), combined with unfinished interventions, intensified erosive processes and generated high socio-environmental costs. Macro-drainage works received millions in public investments but failed to mitigate the impacts. In the Cônsul Assaf Trad Park, a stalled construction project left an environmental liability characterized by active erosion, silted reservoirs, and a dam rupture in 2019. Obstruction of the riverbed by construction waste and clandestine sewage connections was also observed. It is concluded that the lack of urban planning exacerbated the environmental fragility of the watershed, making the adoption of Nature-based Solutions imperative for the recovery and ecological restoration of the area.

Over de HSL, gelegen tussen Hoofddorp en de Belgische grens, rijden zo’n 300 treinen per dag. Het is de enige hogesnelheidslijn in Nederland ontworpen om met 300 kilometer per uur over te rijden. Treinen kunnen echter momenteel over een deel van het traject maar tot 120 kilometer per uur rijden vanwege problemen met de infrastructuur. De lijn is opgeleverd in 2006 en sindsdien is Infraspeed verantwoordelijk voor het beheer en onderhoud van de HSL. Per 1 april 2031 neemt ProRail deze taken over. De HSL staat de komende jaren voor vier samenhangende opgaven die bepalend zijn voor een betrouwbare en toekomstbestendige hogesnel- heidsverbinding. De voorwaarden om dit beeld daadwerkelijk te realiseren zijn op cruciale onderdelen echter nog onvol doende geborgd. Dat vraagt om drie concrete vervolgstappen. 1. Verbind kritieke systeemkeuzes aan een toetsbare uitvoeringsagenda. Stel een aan het NPE gekoppelde uitvoeringsbijlage vast, met per kritieke schakel de verantwoordelijke partij, noodzakelijke besluiten, realisatieplanning, financieringsstatus, onderlinge afhankelijkheden en meetbare prestaties. Verbind de voortgangsrapportage aan de jaarlijkse klimaat- en begrotingscyclus. 2. In het Grevelingenmeer zijn er problemen met de waterkwaliteit en de ecologie, die voor een deel samenhangen met de fysische conditie van het watersysteem. De waargenomen problemen zijn o.a. het optreden van zuurstofloosheid in de diepe delen van de waterkolom, achteruitgang van het bodemleven en het voorkomen van matten van zwavelbacteriën zoals Beggiatoa op de bodem, in zowel de diepere delen als op relatief geringe waterdiepte. Zonder terugkeer van het getij, kan het Grevelingenmeer zich niet duurzaam herstellen en blijven de waterkwaliteit, natuurwaarden en ontwikkelmogelijkheden van het gebied onder grote druk staan. Door het aanleggen van een robuuste verbinding tussen de verschillende waterlichamen ontstaat dynamiek en nieuw leefgebied voor vis, schaal en schelpdieren, Natura 2000-soorten en habitattypen.

items.titel: Spatio-Temporal Dynamics of Urban Heat Islands and Sustainable Urban Development in a Rapidly Urbanizing Tropical City
items.samenvatting_bron: Abstract Rapid urbanization in tropical cities is intensifying surface urban heat island (SUHI) effects, posing significant challenges for sustainable urban planning. Hence, the present study investigates the spatio-temporal dynamics of land surface temperature (LST) and its relationship with vegetation and built-up indices in Raipur district, India, between 2015 and 2025. The multi-temporal Landsat imagery processed on the Google Earth Engine (GEE) was used to derive normalized difference vegetation index (NDVI), normalized difference built-up index (NDBI), and LST, followed by SUHI intensity assessment and correlation analysis. The results reveal a clear spatial pattern in which urban and peri-urban areas exhibit elevated LST values, while vegetated rural zones act as thermal buffers. The NDVI-LST showed a consistent negative correlation (− 0.51 to − 0.33), highlighting the cooling role of vegetation, whereas LST-NDBI showed a consistent strong positive correlation (0.76–0.82), highlighting the warming impact of impervious surfaces. Change detection analysis indicates declining vegetation cover in peri-urban zones and expansion of built-up areas, contributing to outward propagation of thermal hotspots. Although SUHI intensity showed a relative decline over time, this was primarily driven by rising rural temperatures rather than urban cooling, suggesting regional thermal homogenization. items.titel: WILDLIFE UNDERPASSES AS INTEGRATED CIVIL AND ECOLOGICAL INFRASTRUCTURE: A Conceptual Design Framework for Highway Connectivity
items.samenvatting_bron: This report, titled “Wildlife Underpasses as Integrated Civil and Ecological Infrastructure: A Conceptual Design Framework for Highway Connectivity,” examines the integration of civil engineering principles and ecological considerations in the conceptual planning of wildlife underpasses along highways. The report discusses wildlife–vehicle collisions, habitat fragmentation, wildlife-crossing infrastructure, underpass planning and design considerations, drainage and hydraulic requirements, structural and geotechnical considerations, construction practices, maintenance, monitoring, and environmental management. It presents a conceptual framework intended to support safer wildlife movement and improved ecological connectivity across transportation infrastructure. The report is based on a review of relevant literature and published guidance. It is a conceptual technical study and does not claim original field surveys, site-specific investigations, or experimentally validated structural designs. Actual implementation would require site-specific ecological assessments, geotechnical investigations, hydraulic analysis, structural design, and approval by the relevant authorities. Institutional affiliation: Dr. D. Y. Patil Polytechnic, Kasaba Bawada, Kolhapur, Maharashtra, India.

It differs by its terete, sometimes 1–3 branched inflorescence (vs. sub-ancipitous more compressed beneath each floral bract, unbranching), burgundy-maroon flowers with a white and pink column (vs. vinaceous-red with dark purple column), incurved, arcuate, oblanceolate petals, 4.5–4.7 mm long (vs. elliptic, erect, 3 mm long), a lip with a sub-triangular mid-lobe (vs. oblong), and a column bearing setae which are hispid from near the middle to the apex (vs. apically stellate setae). items.titel: Evaluating environmental DNA metabarcoding for describing freshwater fish and shellfish occurrence in an Eastern Cascades watershed
items.samenvatting_bron: Abstract Objective Environmental DNA (eDNA) metabarcoding offers a promising, cost-effective tool to collect data across a large spatial scale, but analyzing these data poses several critical decisions that are uncommon to traditional field sampling. The objective of our study was to evaluate data collection, filtering, and analytical components of occurrence data generated using an eDNA metabarcoding approach. Methods During 2024, we collected replicated water samples from 89 sites distributed across the Wenatchee River Hydrologic Unit Code 8 watershed located in eastern Washington. We processed samples using two metabarcoding markers that targeted the cytochrome c oxidase subunit 1 (CO1; Leray-XT) or 12S ribosomal RNA (MiFish-U) mitochondrial gene region, and we summarized differences in detection, taxonomic coverage, and data filtering requirements for each marker. Finalized metabarcoding data were used to fit occupancy models within a Bayesian framework. We evaluated model results with a focus on species-specific detection probability, the stability of predictions using the full data set and reduced numbers of visited sites, and comparisons between fitting models using a single-species or multispecies occupancy model approach. items.titel: An Open-Source Design Intervention Support Tool for Climate Resilience: Guiding Agroforestry in the Water-Energy-Food-Ecosystems (WEFE) Nexus Systems
items.samenvatting_bron: The TRANS-SAHARA project supports climate change adaptation and mitigation in the Greater Northern African Region through scalable agroforestry systems embedded in a Water-Energy-Food-Ecosystems (WEFE) Nexus framework. This approach recognizes the interdependence of resources and promotes integrated, sustainable solutions in vulnerable contexts. The main objective of this research is to design and develop a decision-making support tool assisting researchers, policymakers, and local stakeholders in planning agroforestry interventions across regional Living Labs, local community-based sites where innovations are co-created and tested with project stakeholders. The tool aims to enable comprehensive analysis by integrating environmental, hydrological, socio-economic, and governance-related data, facilitating an inclusive evaluation of trade-offs and synergies. By incorporating multi-stakeholder perspectives, it supports more holistic and robust decision-making—an essential feature given the inherently multi-factor nature of the optimization problem the project aims to address. Effective collaboration and impact in sustainability research hinge on the open sharing of data and metadata. The tool is built upon Eurac’s research data infrastructure, known as the Environmental Data Platform (EDP). Intratracheal microspray delivery of iohexol for sustained lung-parenchymal enhancement in preclinical micro-computed tomography: A feasibility and acute-safety study in mice
items.samenvatting_bron: by Sheng-Chieh Lin, Kuo-Kai Lin, Kevin Aristyo, Hong-Min Lin, Wei-Hung Liu, Erh-Hsuan Hsieh, Ching-Li Tseng Preclinical thoracic micro-computed tomography (micro-CT) is constrained by the brief pulmonary enhancement window of intravenously (IV) administered iodinated contrast, which the kidneys clear rapidly. We performed a feasibility study in mice comparing IV tail-vein injection with intratracheal microspray instillation of the clinical agent iohexol. Mice received iohexol (100 µL, 500 mg/mL) by either route. Whole-body projections were acquired to 120 min and thoracic sections to 30 min, each animal scanned before contrast in the same session. Contrast distribution was recorded by compartment and quantified from regions of interest. IV delivery produced vascular and cardiac opacification with progressive bladder accumulation, which was the largest signal in every IV animal by 120 min. Intratracheal delivery produced widespread, comparatively uniform lung-parenchymal opacification at 5, 15 and 30 min with no discrete bladder opacity at any time; coronal thoracic signal was 0.77 at 5 min and 0.72 at 30 min, against 0.09 to 0.19 after IV injection. Acute safety was assessed at 5 and 29 h by serum biochemistry and histopathology against untreated controls. ALT, AST and blood urea nitrogen did not differ among groups.
